run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-18T02:24:47Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The frontend request-error alert is caused by the product-catalog Deployment in namespace otel-demo, whose container command was changed to an invalid executable. At 02:22:56Z a new ReplicaSet product-catalog-fcf7564cf was created by Deployment product-catalog (revision 2) carrying command ["invalid-command"] on the same image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog; the old ReplicaSet product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc (command null) was scaled to 0 at 02:23:05Z. The new pods cannot start: kubelet Events and the pod's last termination report 'exec: "invalid-command": executable file not found in $PATH' (StartError, exit 128) and the surviving pod product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l is in CrashLoopBackOff with 5 restarts and ready=false, so Deployment product-catalog reports 0 available/0 ready replicas and the product-catalog Service has only notReadyAddresses. Frontend error spans rose from a zero ratio through 02:23:47Z to 0.197 at 02:25:47Z and 0.51-0.58 thereafter, with the largest error contributor being frontend's grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct calls; checkout and recommendation show their own error spans on ProductCatalogService operations, and frontend-proxy shows ingress/egress errors via frontend. product-catalog itself emits zero spans in the final 10-minute window, consistent with a workload that is not serving at all. The flagd fault flags, including productCatalogFailure and recommendationCacheFailure, are all at defaultVariant "off", and no other deployment in otel-demo carries an invalid command, so the Deployment spec itself is the object holding the fault. Who applied the change cannot be established because the change-history integration is not available in this Run.

claims.text: Deployment product-catalog in namespace otel-demo is at revision 2 and its product-catalog container is configured with command ["invalid-command"] and image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog; a listing of all 21 deployments in otel-demo shows product-catalog as the only one whose container command is ["invalid-command"] (all others null, except flagd's legitimate /flagd-build command).

Deployment product-catalog reports replicas=1 but availableReplicas and readyReplicas are absent (no available/ready replica) while updatedReplicas=1; every other otel-demo deployment reports 1 available and 1 ready replica.

Pod product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l has ready=false, restartCount=5, container state waiting reason CrashLoopBackOff and lastState terminated reason StartError with exitCode 128 and message 'failed to create containerd task: ... exec: "invalid-command": executable file not found in $PATH'; its owner is ReplicaSet product-catalog-fcf7564cf.

Warning Events in otel-demo record reason Failed with 'exec: "invalid-command": executable file not found in $PATH' for pods product-catalog-fcf7564cf-2fvnx (02:23:01Z) and product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l (02:26:26Z), plus reason BackOff for both, while Normal Deployment ScalingReplicaSet events show the old ReplicaSet product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc scaled 1->0 at 02:23:05Z and the new ReplicaSet product-catalog-fcf7564cf scaled up at 02:23:13Z.

Ownership chain: ReplicaSet product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc (created 01:52:55Z, container command null, replicas 0) and ReplicaSet product-catalog-fcf7564cf (created 02:22:56Z, container command ["invalid-command"], replicas 1) are both owned by Deployment product-catalog (uid 36350ca9-8d92-41fe-9007-09bf2fbcd0d9); the Endpoints object product-catalog contains only a notReadyAddresses entry for pod product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l, i.e. no ready backend.

Frontend error-span ratio (traces_span_metrics_calls_total STATUS_CODE_ERROR divided by all frontend spans, 5-minute increase windows, 120s step) was exactly 0 from the first evaluated point (01:28:47Z) through 02:23:47Z, then 0.197 at 02:25:47Z, 0.515 at 02:27:47Z, 0.577 at 02:29:47Z, 0.562 at 02:31:47Z and 0.576 at 02:33:47Z.

In the 20-minute window ending 02:34:19Z frontend's error spans are concentrated on product-catalog and checkout paths: span_name GET 3126.0, grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 2451.2, grpc.oteldemo.RecommendationService/ListRecommendations 468.3, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 313.5 and tcp.connect 17.4 STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans, while frontend's cart and ad client operations (grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, AddItem, grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, GET/POST /api/cart) show 0 error spans.

Product-catalog emitted 7507.4 spans in the 10-minute window ending 02:14:19Z and 6907.4 in the window ending 02:24:19Z, then exactly 0 spans in the window ending 02:34:19Z; the last product-catalog spans in the Jaeger sample were successful oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct server spans (rpc.grpc.status_code 0) started at 02:08:12-02:08:14Z.

Other services' own error spans in the 20 minutes ending 02:34:19Z: checkout 584.5 total, split between oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 292.3 and its oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct client span 292.3; recommendation 945.0 total, split between /oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/ListProducts 471.5 and get_product_list 471.5 (plus 2.06 on /flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream); frontend-proxy 7020.2 total, split between ingress 3514.2 and router frontend egress 3506.0; ad 2.06; fraud-detection 0; payment 0; accounting 0.

The flagd ConfigMap flagd-config holds 12 demo flags - adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure - each with state ENABLED and defaultVariant "off".

The only pods in otel-demo with a non-zero restartCount are product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l (5 restarts, ready=false) and fraud-detection-9fb7d885b-8bpr4 (1 restart, ready=true, started 01:52:56Z); frontend-675fd7b5c5-9f6l5 is Running with 0 restarts and ready=true.

Frontend's request errors are the loss of its product-catalog dependency: frontend's largest error-span group is grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct, the product-catalog Service has no ready endpoint, and the error ratio deviated within the interval between the 02:23:47Z point (0) and the 02:25:47Z point (0.197), i.e. right after the old product-catalog pod was stopped at 02:23:05Z. The exact gRPC error text/status that frontend received is NOT observed, because Jaeger returned no traces for frontend in 02:20-02:34Z.

The change that introduced command ["invalid-command"] was a configuration-only rollout of the Helm release otel-demo (chart opentelemetry-demo-0.38.6, deployment.kubernetes.io/revision 1->2, unchanged image tag 2.1.3-product-catalog, new ReplicaSet created 02:22:56Z); who or what applied it could not be observed because the change-history integration is not available in this Run.

Rejected: the flagd fault flag productCatalogFailure (or another demo fault flag) drove the failure. All 12 flags are ENABLED with defaultVariant "off", and the observed fault is a container start error (exec not found) rather than an error response produced by a running product-catalog.

Rejected: OOMKill or resource exhaustion killed the product-catalog container. The container's last termination reason is StartError with exitCode 128 and the exec-not-found message, and no Evicted or OOMKilled evidence appears for these pods.

Rejected: the fraud-detection restart at 02:12:59Z is part of this incident. Fraud-detection contributes 0 error spans in the 20 minutes ending 02:34:19Z, its pod is ready with 1 restart, and its deployment reports 1/1 available replicas.

The frontend workload itself is up: pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-9f6l5 is Running with ready=true and 0 restarts, Deployment frontend reports 1/1 available/ready at revision 1, so frontend is not the origin of the fault - its errors are on outbound spans toward its dependencies.

Restore the product-catalog Deployment's container command to the chart's default (remove the command ["invalid-command"] override) and roll the Deployment so a ReplicaSet with a valid command replaces product-catalog-fcf7564cf; then confirm Deployment product-catalog returns to 1 available replica and the product-catalog Endpoints get a ready address.

Review the source of the Helm/CI values that produced revision 2 of Deployment product-catalog (release otel-demo, chart opentelemetry-demo-0.38.6) and add a guard so a container command override cannot be shipped for this workload.

gaps: The change-history integration is not available in this Run, so who or what changed the product-catalog container command (and the precise edit time) is unknown; only the effect (new ReplicaSet created 02:22:56Z) was observed.

No Prometheus alerting rule named RequestErrorRate was returned (list_prometheus_rules queries with rule_name=RequestErrorRate and type=alert both returned nothing), so the alert expression and the reported value 16.8667 could not be verified.

Jaeger returned no traces for service frontend in 02:20:00-02:34:19Z (empty result) and none for recommendation with tags error=true, so the exact gRPC/HTTP error text frontend received from product-catalog during the outage was not observed; the last product-catalog spans in the returned sample are at 02:08:12-02:08:14Z.

Frontend pod logs read returned 0 lines for frontend-675fd7b5c5-9f6l5 in 02:20-02:34Z, and product-catalog-fcf7564cf-vjj7l has no previous container log instance, so no application log line confirms the dependency error text.

A cluster-wide ConfigMap search for the string 'invalid-command' returned nothing (query status no_data), so it remains unverified whether any ConfigMap or other object also references that command; only the Deployment and its ReplicaSet were seen to carry it.
Whether any flagd targeting rule would switch a fault variant on at runtime (beyond the observed defaultVariant "off") was not examined.
